integrity: The map count, component decomposition, homology profile, and isolated-map identification are reconstructed from the stated finite orders and replayed by the included verifier. Historical bibliographic access limitations are disclosed in the review.
scientific limitations: Specific to the product sixteen-point finite torus and the four-point circle; no subdivision-depth theorem and no claim for the other sixteen-point minimal torus model.
title: Nine homotopy classes of direct maps from the minimal finite torus to the four-point circle
